period: FY2012, FY2019–FY2020, FY2022–FY2025 (7 years; FY2006–FY2011, FY2013–FY2018 and FY2021 not sourced — see sources)
sources: MOF general account budget, major expenses breakdown (当初ベース, initial-budget/decision basis), accessed Oct 2026
FY2022–FY2025: MOF 'General account expenditure trends (initial basis)' table, https://www.mof.go.jp/policy/budget/fiscal_condition/basic_data/202604/sy202604d.pdf
FY2020: MOF 'FY2020 Budget Highlights' (令和２年度予算のポイント), https://www.mof.go.jp/budget/budger_workflow/budget/fy2020/seifuan2019/01.pdf — full amounts including 臨時・特別の措置 (temporary special measures)
FY2019: Wikipedia '平成三十一年度一般会計' transcribing MOF 概算 (as-decided figures, total 101,4571億); FY2012: Wikipedia '平成二十四年度一般会計' transcribing MOF 概算
FX: ~/workspace/countries/data/profiles/Japan-profile.json (fx_lcu_per_usd_annual_avg, JPY per USD; ECB via Frankfurter annual avg)
Gaps: FY2006–FY2011, FY2013–FY2018, FY2021 omitted — no consistently-sourced initial-budget major-expense breakdown found; not estimated.

category_mapping.defense: 防衛関係費 (national defense expenses). FY2023 figure (101,686億) includes the multi-year Defense Buildup Fund allocation per MOF note.
category_mapping.health_note: MOF major-expense tables do not split medical/long-term-care out of social security in this series; all social security kept whole in social_protection (no false precision).
category_mapping.education: 文教及び科学振興費 (education & science promotion) in full. The science/R&D slice (e.g. うち科学技術振興費 13,639億 in FY2020) is not separable in the trend-series table, so kept here; documented rather than estimated.
category_mapping.social_protection: 社会保障関係費 (pensions, medical, long-term care, welfare, child/family support) + 恩給関係費 (pensions for former military/civil servants). MOF does not split medical from pensions in this series.
category_mapping.economic_affairs: 公共事業関係費 (public works/infrastructure) + 中小企業対策費 (SME support) + エネルギー対策費 (energy) + 食料安定供給関係費 (food/agriculture stability). 産業投資特別会計へ繰入 and 改革推進公共投資事業 are zero/blank in FY2022–FY2025 in the source table.
category_mapping.general_admin: 地方交付税交付金等 (local allocation tax grants + local special grants; general-purpose intergovernmental transfer to local governments, not attributable to any function — placed here, not in 'other'). Includes 地方特例交付金 from FY2005 per MOF note.
category_mapping.debt_interest: 国債費 — includes BOTH interest payments and debt redemption under Japan's 60-year redemption rule (not interest-only). FY2020 split observed: 利払費等 84,200億 / 債務償還費 149,316億.
category_mapping.public_order_note: Police/courts/prisons sit inside その他の事項経費 (other current expenses) and are not separable in the MOF major-expense breakdown; set null rather than estimated.
category_mapping.other: 経済協力費 (ODA) + その他の事項経費 (other current expenses, incl. central police/courts/admin) + 予備費 (contingency reserve) + year-specific reserves: FY2012 経済危機対応予備費; FY2022–FY2024 新型コロナ/原油価格・物価高騰対策予備費 (renamed over time per MOF notes). FY2022 ウクライナ情勢経済緊急対応予備費 (10,000億) is shown in the MOF table but excluded: it was added via supplementary budget after the Dec-2021 initial decision and is not part of the official initial total 1,075,964億.

fiscal_year_note: Japanese fiscal year runs April–March; FY2023 = Apr 2023–Mar 2024. calendar_year is the ending year. All figures are initial budget (当初予算, government-draft/decision basis), consistently. FY2025 uses the decided figure (1,151,978億) despite later Diet amendments (Mar 2025).
unit: percent of total general-account expenditure; USD billions
notes: Reconciliation: for FY2012, FY2019, FY2022, FY2024, FY2025 the mapped components sum to the official total within rounding (diff ≤2億). FY2020 components sum 1,000億 (0.1%) below the official total — minor source-table variance, pct sums to 99.8%. FY2023 components sum 9,998億 (0.9%) below the official total — the MOF trend table's R5 rows do not fully reconcile to the stated total; pct sums to 99.1%. Both within the 100±1.5 tolerance; pct computed against the official total.
FY2023 defense spike (8.9%) reflects the new National Security Strategy / defense buildup; FY2024 falls back to 7.0% as the one-off fund allocation drops out.
health and public_order are null (not zero) — inseparable in source, per schema.
